t: This is Trellick Tower, a Grade II* listed Brutalist tower block on the Cheltenham Estate in Kensal Town. It opened in 1972, commissioned by the Greater London Council and designed by Ernő Goldfinger. It was planned to replace outdated social housing, and was meant as an improvement on his earlier Balfron Tower in Poplar. It was the last major project he worked on. Notice the separate access tower beside the main block, which contains a plant room.
